name: Julie Ross
source:
Occupation: Vigilante
Notable Traits: Psychotic tendencies, anger issues

A vigilante haunted by her past resulting an unhealthy obsession to justice.

Proficient in several forms of martial arts, especially in Krav Maga, she is a deadly adversary in hand-to-hand combat with no qualms in hurting people who deserve it by her judgment.

Trusts no man, she has not met a person on whom she can actually depend on.

Her past shaped who she is today, and she joined forces with Ciel and Arthur to achieve a goal of her own.

[spoiler]Her real name is Julie McKellen, daughter of DynaTec's CEO, Richard McKellen.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/716330/VOID/]Steam[/url] and [url=http://void.vifthfloor.moe/img/julie.png]Character Profile[/url]]
